question: Write the expression for electric field due to an infinite plane sheet of charge. How does this field depend on distance from the sheet? Justify your answer.

options.C: $E=\frac{\sigma}{2\varepsilon_0}$ and it is independent of distance from the sheet
options.D: $E=\frac{\sigma}{4\pi\varepsilon_0r^2}$ and it is directed along the sheet
